articles.title: Commercial Real Estate Owners Are Embracing AI, Risks and All
articles.summary: Commercial real estate owners hold diverse views on artificial intelligence, ranging from cautious enthusiasm to significant concerns regarding its risks. Some express a reluctant acceptance of AI's growing influence, while others anticipate its transformative potential. This spectrum of opinions highlights the complex challenges and strategic considerations AI presents for the sector, shaping future investment and operational strategies.

This observation highlights the contrast with their own reliance on prepared papers at the podium. articles.title: Keeping the edge sharp: India looks to build a global military MRO hub
articles.summary: India is strategically working to become a global hub for military Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO). This initiative is crucial for enhancing the operational readiness of its armed forces and promoting self-reliance in defence equipment maintenance. By developing world-class MRO capabilities, India aims to cater to its own defence needs and attract international partners, significantly bolstering its defence industry and strategic positioning.

articles.title: In 1944, a German U-boat sank the SS Cornwallis off Maine, killing 43 sailors; 82 years later, a dive team ended a seven-year search by locating the wreck almost 400 feet underwater in July 2026
articles.summary: In 1944, a German U-boat sank the SS Cornwallis off Maine, claiming the lives of 43 sailors during World War II. After 82 years, a dedicated dive team successfully concluded a seven-year search. They recently located the historic wreck, bringing closure to a significant maritime mystery. This discovery highlights a pivotal moment from the war's Atlantic theatre.
